from: The FIA Formula One Technical Delegate
incident_time: 12:40 2022 AUSTRALIAN GRAND PRIX 7 - 10 April 2022 Technical Delegate's Report Last Wednesday personnel of the Haas F1 Team, who are associated with the operation of the car, were within the confines of the circuit during the thirteen hour period which commenced at 19:00 on 06 April, fourtytwo hours before the scheduled start time of P1 and ends twentynine hours before the scheduled start time of P1 at 08:00 on 07 April. This was the first of the eight individual exceptions permitted for the Haas F1 Team during the 2022 Formula One Championship season and therefore no action should be taken. The FIA Formula One Technical Delegate Jo Bauer
